# Callouts

Two admonition syntaxes appear in the wild. Both are kept here as plain text.

## GitHub alerts

> [!NOTE]
> Alerts are blockquotes that start with a marker line.

> [!WARNING]
> Test keys never move real money; live keys do.

## Docusaurus fences

:::note
Fenced admonitions open and close with three colons.
:::

:::danger[Careful]
Deleting a customer cannot be undone.
:::
